title: SLA focus-row hit-rect is narrower than the drawn selected chip; chip is opaque against the translucent 5.5 chrome idiom
evidence:
app/main.odin:1252 (sla_focus_click): `rect := rl.Rectangle{12, f32(sla_row_y(&app.view, line) - 2), 720, 18}`
app/main.odin:1383 (draw_sla_gauges): `rl.DrawRectangle(8, sla_row_y(&app.view, line) - 2, 740, 18, rl.Color{250, 232, 228, 255})`
detail: Hit-test spans x 12-732 but the drawn selected chip spans x 8-748, so clicks on the chip's ~16px edges do nothing; the chip is fully opaque (alpha 255) where the popover chrome idiom is translucent warm cards + hairline border.
recommended_fix: Share one rect (e.g. {8, row_y-2, 740, 18}) from a single helper used by both draw and hit-test; consider alpha ~240 to match the popover card idiom.
